name: contextmeter
description: Local-first CLI for measuring prompt context files against token budgets.

scripts.smoke: npm run build && node dist/cli.js scan fixtures/docs-heavy --config fixtures/docs-heavy/contextmeter.json && node dist/cli.js scan fixtures/source-heavy --config fixtures/source-heavy/contextmeter.json --format json
scripts.release:check: npm run check && npm test && npm run smoke && npm run package:smoke

author: Roger Chappel
